value.qualifies: Count living targetable Heroes by Area; maximum positive count across the bound Tile, before range movement; no Heroes means no target.
value.candidateGeneration: All maximum-count valid Tile Areas; preserve count and actor identities used to generate candidates.
value.tie: One candidate resolves directly; multiple require explicit player PendingChoice.
value.stableOrdering: Ascending Area ID using code-point comparison; ordering is display only, never implicit selection.
value.invalidSelection: Reject missing candidates, unknown selection, stale occupancy, forged actor IDs, wrong action key/version; no RNG consumed.

items.reason: Explicit Prophet-only versioned contract; not runtime implementation or official rule.

value.attackOrdering: Physical copy ordinal 1, 2, 3, 4 explicitly, independent of array/storage order.
value.sameArea: Each active Pew gets an independent attack/roll even when another Pew has attacked that Area.
value.cursor: 0..4 completed Pew transactions; pendingPewAttack stores copy ordinal, targets, roll and phase.
value.damageTransaction: Use shared attack/damage; freeze target order by authoritative Hero Stance then stable actor ID; journal transaction ID before cursor advancement.
value.deathWindows: Resolve shared death/Death Door and stress windows for each target before next target; complete all targets before next Pew.
value.conditionWindows: Apply target effects only on hit after damage; generic condition ticks remain at actor turn start, not at Pew boundaries.
value.interruption: Persist pending attack phase, resolved target IDs, RNG cursor and causal events when shared PendingChoice interrupts.
value.resume: Continue uncommitted target/phase from journal; never reroll a stored roll or repeat committed damage/death events.
value.removedInvalidTarget: A legally removed dead Hero is skipped with causal event; forged/unknown Area, copy or actor fails validation. Empty Area still consumes its Pew attack roll.
value.roundReset: Require prior sequence complete; reuse four physical copy IDs, atomically clear old placements and assign four new shared-stream rolls; no stale ownership.
value.victory: Cancel remaining attacks, return all four physical Pews once, retain causal journal.
